body: General rule for a game whose random choices come from hardware (POKEY random register, free-running counters) that no deterministic RNG reproduces: the stored trace supplies the choice, everything downstream is verified exactly, and the fed keys are named in the oracle docs. BewareILive: confirm whether your Williams RNG rows use the same rule (robotron.rng.callers suggests you model the RNG instead); record the difference in docs/sync.md if deliberate.
source: vectorcraft chat 2026-10-21 07:11 PDT (Tempest); precedent Omega Race placements and Star Castle mines; VectorCraft docs/decisions.md
summary: verify may feed the trace's random choices (Tempest enemy lanes and release order) into the core, as it feeds Omega Race's placements and Star Castle's mines; the game's own RNG picks them in play
